The '''Office of the General''', also known as the '''Office of the General of the Separatist Army''' was the central command division of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] overseen by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] the Office of the General issued a decree increasing [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] security, prompted by recent incursions into [[Neimoidian space]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scouting missions. In response, the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legion]] doubled their conscription rate and called up all reservist for active duty to protect [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidia]] and her [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] from the war.<ref name="Neimoidians Double Conscription Rate">{{InsiderCite|71|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition}}</ref> After [[Jyvus Space City]] fell to the Confederacy during [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], [[Neimoidian irregulars]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] turned the city into a field command station for the Office of the General.<ref name="Breaking News: Confederacy Storms Duro">{{InsiderCite|74|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition}}</ref>
